name: Ecology and Evolutionary Biology PhD
summary: Research PhD in ecology and evolutionary biology with faculty research advisers.
detailsNote: Application page explicitly welcomes Fall 2027 applicants. Funding rates are for academic year 2026–2027. Fee-waiver deadline is published annually without a year. Prior faculty correspondence is strongly encouraged; a compulsory adviser commitment or rotation model was not established.

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application, all materials
deadlines.note: Same deadline for domestic and international applicants; fall entry only.

publishedDeadlines.label: Need-based fee-waiver request
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual undated deadline; most application sections and recommendation requests must be complete. Confirm cycle.

documents: Unofficial transcripts (official sealed copies if offered admission)
List of potential faculty advisers and correspondence, if any

english.toefl: 79 iBT/Home Edition before January 21, 2026; 4.0 overall on/after January 21, 2026
english.note: IELTS/IELTS Online: no section below 6; One Skill Retake excluded. PTE Academic 60, CEPT Full Academic 110 or CESL endorsement also accepted; DET and doctoral TOEFL Essentials excluded. Scores within two years of enrollment. Exemptions: English-official citizenship, completed US accredited bachelor/graduate degree or approved English Proficiency Guide degree; unfinished degree may qualify with two full-time years and 48 upper-division undergraduate or 30 graduate graded credits at US/approved institutions, credits within two years. English-medium instruction alone does not exempt. International teaching appointments have separate speaking requirements. EEB GTA: legacy TOEFL speaking 24 or IELTS overall 7.5; central updated TOEFL speaking 5 applies to tests on/after January 21, 2026.

applicationFee.note: Limited departmental need-based waivers. Email coordinator with GradApp name, prospective labs and up to half-page single-spaced financial-strain explanation; evidence of undergraduate need if applicable, documentation may be requested. Start and mostly complete GradApp by November 15 at 17:00 Tucson; recommendation requests initiated, letters and SOP need not yet be uploaded. Notification November 29. No citizenship restriction stated; international applicants should confirm eligibility. Central Graduate College does not grant general email waivers.

requirements.note: Biology-related bachelor equivalent recommended; related MS applicants welcome; research desirable, not essential. Correspond directly with potential faculty and list interests/contact. No departmental GRE policy established; central Graduate College does not require GRE but departments may. Interviews January 24–26, 2027; FAQ generic early-February schedule is superseded by current application page.

funding.note: Every effort to support satisfactory doctoral students for first ten semesters, except arrangements at acceptance; beyond third year depends on dissertation progress. Primarily GTA, also RA/fellowships. Published 2026–2027 rates: assistant $12,827/semester; associate after comprehensive exam $13,937/semester; tuition (in/out-of-state) and year-round health insurance. Mandatory, course, international and program fees remain student responsibility. International GTAs eligible subject to higher English standards; not an unconditional all-funded guarantee.
